scope: Wrapper parent-path semantics relevant to existing direct plugin-prefix guards
source_contracts: Player.FolderPath maps to PLAYER_PATH and GetFileInfoLabelValueFromPath, which calls URIUtils::GetParentPath.
Generic ListItem.Path also calls GetParentPath; ListItem.FolderPath instead returns the complete item URL without user details.
VideoGUIInfo handles video-tag paths separately, but calls GetParentPath for non-folder file paths.
URIUtils unwraps stack via StackDirectory::GetParentPath and multipath via decoded first path before recursing.
The plugin branch removes query options or the plugin route before returning its parent; resulting prefixes remain plugin://.
StackDirectory::GetBasePath compares normalized parents. Native same-provider examples resolve to the plugin root.
conclusion: Existing ListItem.Path plugin-prefix guard passes four plugin cases, including nested encoded wrappers, and preserves three local parent paths. No additional blanket protocol filtering justified by these cases.
